alishahryar1/free-claude-code.caption:
Claude Code costs $200/month. This open-source tool does the same thing… for FREE. 🤯

CLAURST is a terminal-based AI coding agent built in Rust that:

→ Reads & writes your entire codebase
→ Executes commands autonomously
→ Supports 15+ AI providers (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Ollama)
→ Has ZERO telemetry
